items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: And that’s how I got started hearing Duke Ellington, Basie, and Fastolo Wolloro.

ctx.x: In Missouri, what kind of music did you hear as a child growing up?

Well there was a radio station in St. Louis, and they had a little program on there called “Harlem Rhythm,” a 15 minute program every morning. And that’s how I got started hearing Duke Ellington, Basie, and Fastolo Wolloro.
